limits: No physical office/integrated/gamingGPU benchmark is available in this cloud executor.
Firstpreparation time is recorded independently, not hidden inside FPS.

checks: Real uninterrupted WebGL draws, pointer lock and trusted firing advance state and consume ammunition

Escape restores controls and pauses authority

Primary training start remains reachable across seven required desktop/mobile viewport sizes
Actual frozen simulation-2 replay file imports and verifies through the browser UI

method.maps: Original authored geometry loaded from frozen worktree, exact geometry comparison, no synthetic scaling
method.queryMix: Original route/defender human samples plus seeded map-wide rays; separate authored face/inside/near-parallel/floor edge cases
method.parity: assert.deepStrictEqual, preserves signed zero, exact distance/points/normals/material/thickness/segments/order, all four weapons
method.performance: Same query objects and original obstacle arrays; nearest retains original linear scan, occlusion exits after first exact hit, ballistics uses ordered BVH candidates; warmup, alternating order, fifteen calibrated repeated-batch samples targeting 20 ms of baseline work (bounded to 256 passes); no wall-time CI gate
method.currentVision: materials-v3 visibility checked against original nearest tests over current sight-blocking obstacles; separate module instances isolate oracle/v3 feedback from legacy timings; separately timed on actual current arrays with no legacy speedup ratio
method.scope: CPU query kernels only; does not claim GPU or end-to-end frame speedup

method.mapGeometry: Original authored range, complex and tower maps
method.order: Alternating baseline/current legacy/current materials order per round
method.wholeStep: Uninstrumented step wall time measured around each actual Simulation.step; excludes constructing input and scene
method.component: Separate run with prototype wrappers; inclusive elapsed and self time excluding wrapped nested calls; contains wrapper/timer overhead, not subtracted
method.perception: DefenderAI.visible private runtime prototype method measured independently from DefenderAI.step; no cadence change
method.ballistics: Standalone imported function is not prototype wrapped. See QUERY_BENCHMARK-FINAL.json for exact per-ray kernel timings; this report makes no per-step ballistic attribution.

limits: CPU-only Node SSR workload; not browser, GPU, office or gaming hardware performance.
Current material rules intentionally change contacts/materials, so trajectory equality is checked only between frozen baseline and current legacy rules.
If a real scene kills the player, the run ends naturally and actual measured tick count is recorded.
Component self times exclude only the named wrapped nested functions, not all transitive callees.

Early repeats can show JIT/warmup variation despite the initial range warmup and 120 untimed ticks per scene. This finite series supports bounded workload/call attribution, not a conclusive whole-step speedup claim.
